text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm walking by the river...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Did I mess up the equation? No,
there's no
way. That must mean it's the
data that's...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What do you want? This has got nothing
to do
with—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the problem might be that I
don't have enough data. Hey, get your
ass over here. I've got
a question for
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing some simulations based on my
heart
rate data, but I'm not getting the
results I want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur proceeds to expand on her

mathematical formulas in great detail,
but it all
goes over my head...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, forget it. I'm giving up on this
approach. It's
no good.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no crap. What else do you think I
was
going to do? That's what I meant by
giving up on
this approach.
choice_data_list: Tell her that results will come wi...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just because I can't prove my formula
doesn't
mean I'm gonna leave it
half-finished.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, I'm not gonna bury my head
in the sand if it still doesn't work after
that, but I know
my math's good, so I'm
not giving up yet. Later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur changes gears in a flash and
walks off, her tablet in hand. I have no
doubt that her
persistence will get her
the results she wants.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you saying I haven't tested my
math enough times? I've crunched the
numbers more
times than you can
believe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Besides, blindly chasing after results just because you think there's a possibility something might come out of it is stu—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Maybe the conditions I applied
to my trials weren't thorough enough. I
should input the
data and run the
numbers again...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch Air Shakur for a while after that,
and her
formula seems to produce a
satisfactory answer in
the end.
